The Vendetta Gazette

Vol. XII • June 15, 2026 • “All the Blood That’s Fit to Print” • Two Cents (If You’re Still Alive to Pay)

★ TERRITORY GAINS THIS WEEK ★ Sir Caprice        +36 turfs
Donald Trump      +22 turfs
Free Willy         +6 turfs
Cokro              +5 turfs
Wu-Tang           +2 turfs
Hamed's DVD       +1 turf

The Executioner's Waltz — Sir Caprice Eliminates Three Bosses in One Bloody Week

Rachel, Febrydz, and C0nFate Swept from the Map; The Sovereign of Streets Shows No Sign of Mercy By Our Man in the Trenches, Ignatius P. Flambeau

This correspondent has, in the course of a long and occasionally harrowing career chronicling the affairs of Vendetta City's most violent and ambitious personages, witnessed many a remarkable spectacle. Yet the week ending the fifteenth of June in this Year of Our Lord nineteen and twenty-six has furnished scenes of such concentrated, methodical destruction that even the most battle-hardened reader may feel the need to clutch their bourbon glass a little tighter before proceeding.

Sir Caprice — that immaculate, devastating engine of territorial conquest whom this publication christened the Titan of the Map just one week past — has returned with thirty-six new turfs laid at his feet like tribute, and three enemy headquarters smashed to rubble beneath his bespoke Italian heel. Three bosses. Three headquarters. Three eliminations. In a single week. The city does not gasp, dear readers; it has forgotten how.

First to fall, on the second of June, was Rachel — a modest operator whose single remaining turf proved insufficient fortress against the Caprice juggernaut. Then, in a double stroke of administrative finality on the fifth, Febrydz and C0nFate were both dispatched before the afternoon edition could reach the newsstands. All three, stripped of their last footholds, are presumed to be nursing wounds and counting what meagre resources remain to them. Sir Caprice, meanwhile, has grown his already-formidable army by a staggering 830 garrison units, bringing his total to six thousand, five hundred and thirty-one — a number so vast it strains the credulity of this newspaper's typesetter.

★ Special Bulletin: The Triple Execution of June Fifth ★ On the afternoon of June 5th, Sir Caprice — having already dispatched Rachel to oblivion three days prior — turned his gaze upon two further unfortunates in a single sun-setting session of carnage. Febrydz, long rumoured to be seeking alliance with more powerful factions, never got the chance to make his introductions. C0nFate, whose very name suggested a philosophical resignation to destiny, found that destiny delivered rather more promptly than anticipated. Both headquarters were stormed, both flags pulled down, both bosses left without a street corner to call their own. The city's undertakers, we are reliably informed, have taken on seasonal staff.

Trump's Double Game — The Golden Conqueror Robs and Rules in Equal Measure

Twenty-Two Turfs Seized; Wcrypto and Gpug GIka Bled Dry by the Relentless Deal-Maker By Our Society Correspondent, Millicent V. Hardcastle

If Sir Caprice is the iron fist of Vendetta City, then Donald Trump — "The Golden Leverager," as the street boys have taken to calling him — is the man who takes your territory and your wallet on the way out the door. This week, Trump posted a net gain of twenty-two turfs while simultaneously conducting twenty-three raids upon the city's more vulnerable establishments, making him the most prolific looter and the second-most voracious conqueror of the entire week.

His principal victims were the hapless Wcrypto, captured from no fewer than twenty-five times over the course of the week and raided twenty-two times for good measure, and Gpug GIka, who suffered nineteen territorial assaults and fifteen separate lootings. Between them, these two unfortunate operations have been reduced to shadows of their former selves — Wcrypto
